altem_guardians.description: Two towering knights in gleaming golden full plate with winged helmets, side by side behind huge ornate shields, halberds upright, a soft white glow behind them.

altem_mages.description: Two ancient sorcerers in white and gold robes with tall golden headdresses, floating side by side, small orbs of red, blue, white and green energy circling between their raised hands, pale sky.

amotep_freezers.description: Two soldiers in heavy bronze and dark blue armor with crested helmets, aiming ornate tube weapons that spray a jet of freezing blue frost, ice forming on the ground.

amotep_gunners.description: Two soldiers in heavy bronze and dark red armor with crested helmets, firing ornate hand cannons in a burst of red fire and smoke, dusky background.

catapults.description: A large wooden catapult seen from the side, its arm swinging up to hurl a flaming boulder, two engineers in leather aprons beside it, open field.

fire_golems.description: Two hulking golems of cracked black volcanic rock, molten lava glowing through the cracks, flaming fists raised, dark red haze behind them.

fire_mages.description: Two battle mages in crimson and gold robes, one hurling a roaring fireball from the hands, the other raising a burning staff, swirling embers, orange glow.

foresters.description: Two woodsmen in green hooded tunics, one with an axe on the shoulder and one with a longbow, walking along a forest path between mossy trunks.

guardian_golems.description: Two massive grey granite golems with glowing blue runes on their chests, broad slab-like arms raised as shields, standing guard, plain stone background.

herbalists.description: Two village healers in green and brown robes kneeling in a sunny glade, one gathering flowers into a basket, one grinding herbs in a mortar, small glowing remedies.

ice_golems.description: Two hulking golems of jagged translucent blue ice, frost crystals on their shoulders, freezing mist around their feet, pale snowy background.

ice_mages.description: Two battle mages in pale blue and white robes, casting a beam of frost and shards of ice from crystal-topped staffs, swirling snowflakes.

illusionists.description: A hooded mage in a deep purple cloak, face half hidden, flanked by two shimmering ghostly copies of the same mage, swirling violet mist.

northern_monks.description: Two monks in thick blue and white fur-lined robes in a fighting stance with wooden staves, breath frosting in the cold air, snowy pines behind.

peasants.description: Three angry peasants in ragged brown and grey clothes, armed with a pitchfork, a club and a scythe, standing together on a muddy village road.

red_cape_monks.description: Two bald warrior monks in flowing red capes and orange robes, in martial arts stances, fists wreathed in red fire, mountain mist behind.

savage_monks.description: Two wild monks with painted skin and bone necklaces, leaping forward with clawed gauntlets and a spear, green jungle haze behind.

utem_crossbowmen.description: Two soldiers in steel helmets and blue-and-silver tabards, one kneeling and one standing, aiming heavy crossbows, a stone wall behind.

utem_guardsmen.description: Three guards in heavy steel plate with blue tabards, shoulder to shoulder behind tall rectangular tower shields, long spears lowered, an unbreakable shield wall.

utem_swordsmen.description: Two veteran swordsmen in steel breastplates and blue tabards, longswords raised and round shields forward, charging, dust behind them.
